behavior: AC1: the 404 page is written by the catalog build and by the end build, and the end build publishes exactly the old set plus it
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_not_found.py tests/test_end_of_sale.py -k 'top_level_404 or nothing_but'

behavior: AC2: both languages, links to / and /es/, noindex
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_not_found.py -k 'both_languages or own_home_page or out_of_search'

behavior: AC3: no phone, sms:/tel:, const _C, script, item id or price in either mode
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_not_found.py -k 'no_phone or no_item'

behavior: AC4: every reference is root-absolute, resolves the same from any depth and is a file of the site
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_not_found.py -k 'any_depth or file_of_the_site or compiled_stylesheet'

behavior: AC5: the end build keeps the page through the sweep and its redirects do not catch it
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_not_found.py -k 'sweeps or swallow'

behavior: AC6: smoke.sh asserts a 404 with the not-found body in both modes, and fails on a 200 or a foreign 404
AC7: every class of not_found.html has a rule in the compiled CSS
